name: Cloudburst replay · 08 July 2026 (synthetic reconstruction)
note: Rain series shaped after MCGM AWS 15-min records from real Mumbai cloudburst afternoons (~205 mm in 3 h); tide curve shaped after a spring-tide cycle peaking ~4.5 m, which seals gravity outfalls mid-storm. Values are reconstructed for the replay demo — the live system reads the same shape from dm.mcgm.gov.in.
